realizes.rationale: The filename only locates a candidate document. _resolve now requires its native identifier to equal the requested ID before crediting revision/origin. The exact old positive still resolves INV-AAAAAA revision1; substituting native INV-BBBBBB revision77 now gives unreadable with target revision/origin null, never false absence or borrowed revision. A4 typed owners, sidecars/history and same-depth continuation are preserved.

Ordinary, resumed and symlink reads are streamed with measured consumption; an offset beyond MAX_SCAN_BYTES now refuses before any blob read (independent actualRead=0). Resumed prefix work is deducted from the finite scan budget. Packet path/collection caps, relationship path/byte/depth/page caps, bounded ls-tree streaming and a per-walk indexed lookup remain enforced; two-size and boundary tests pass. This credits bounded legitimate investigation, not unlimited-store-reader behavior owned by F10.

1.note: A relationship edge is reported from the owner that records it, with its own semantics.

2.note: A resolved target must carry the requested native identifier; a filename alone is only a locator.

3.note: A memory file this build does not read is invalid rather than absent.
